requests.reply:
Early in the morning, the mist still lingered outside the mountain gate.
"舟, you've finally returned. Did you bring enough spirit stones?"
I brought three bags, all of which are the best from the back mountain.
The ward has been damaged again last night, and Elder Qin didn't sleep at all.

Before he could finish speaking, Wanqi Jing rushed up from below.
He gasped, "There's a young woman lying on the side of the road near the foot of the mountain."
Quickly lift it up. Ruoshui, please fetch the healing medicine.
Wan Si Jing rushed into the main hall, carrying the unconscious woman, and the iron badge on his waist read: "Qiu Shuang."
If the injury isn't serious, just a depletion of spiritual energy, give her a pill to restore it.

Sister Zang, Elder Qin asked me to go to the ward area. I'm here with Senior Wan Si.
Okay. I'll go get Ms. Chou right away.
Wan Si Jing scratched his head and then turned to run towards the foot of the mountain.
解玄 stood at the entrance to the hall, his sword still sheathed, but the light flickered for a moment.
Elder Qin, how have you been? I have come at the order of the pavilion master to collect three shares of qi stones.

Three-tenths of a qi stone? That's the sect's hard-earned savings. When would outsiders be allowed to take them?

The wards are already damaged, and the qi stones won't be safe in your hands. I'll return in three days.
解玄 let out a cold laugh and turned to leave, not even bothering to look back.
He said three days, and he always keeps his word.
Elder Qin stroked his beard and looked at the sleeping Xu Shuang on the mat.

Elder, let me go and guard the ward. Miss Chou has Mr. Le to take care of her, so I can leave.
Finally, he nodded and took out a jade token from his sleeve.
This is the key to the ward. By protecting it, you are protecting your own path.
乐川 put the medicine pouch in Yunzhou's arms, and then quietly reminded him of a few things.

At the entrance of the mountain, Wan Si Jing handed me a蓑衣 (蓑衣).
"Thank you, Wan Si Jing." I said to the girl, "Tell Chu'er that I'm awake."
Shàn Yúnzhōu nodded, carefully tucking the ward-keeping order away.
Inside the hall, Ms. Chou slowly opened her eyes.
It's alright, you've been unconscious for a whole day. Please stay still. ▼

仇霜 struggled to sit up, looking out at the torn sky.
Unnoticed, a note in his sleeve was sealed with 解玄's seal.
